items.en: Hello, everybody.
items.zh: 大家好

items.en: I'm Allison Chinchar in for Koi Wire, and you're watching CNN 10.
items.zh: 我是艾莉森·钦查尔，代班主持科伊·怀尔的节目，您正在收看CNN 10

items.en: Now, today is Monday, September 21st.
items.zh: 今天是9月21日，星期一

items.en: Let's get to your news.
items.zh: 我们来看看今天的新闻

items.en: We begin in South Africa, where officials are trying to address a problem
items.zh: 我们从南非开始，当地官员试图解决一个问题，

items.en: at the intersection of public safety and nature conservation.
items.zh: 这个问题涉及公共安全与自然保护的交叉点

items.en: Troops of baboons are roaming neighborhoods in Cape Town, damaging property
items.zh: 成群的狒狒在开普敦的社区里游荡，破坏财物，

items.en: and causing residents to fear for their safety.
items.zh: 让居民为自己的安全感到担忧

items.en: CNN's Larry Madowo explains a controversial plan to address the problem. CNN
items.zh: 的拉里· 马多沃来解释一项有争议的解决方案

items.en: Cape Town residents are taking notice of a growing controversy
items.zh: 开普敦居民注意到一场日益加剧的争议，

items.en: over baboons and what to do about them.
items.zh: 围绕着狒狒以及该如何处理它们

items.en: Troops of baboons are roaming the streets, raiding homes and riling up residents.
items.zh: 成群的狒狒在街上游荡，闯入住宅，惹恼居民

items.en: These chakma baboons are Southern Africa's largest monkey species.
items.zh: 这些查克马狒狒是南部非洲体型最大的猴类

items.en: And as the city expands, conflict between baboons and residents has grown.
items.zh: 随着城市扩张，狒狒与居民之间的冲突也在增加

items.en: And now the city has a plan to solve their primate problem,
items.zh: 现在这座城市有了一个解决灵长类动物问题的计划，

items.en: permanently cage around 60 of the animals as an alternative to culling.
items.zh: 永久圈养大约60只狒狒，以此替代扑杀

items.en: And then we're left with two very difficult decisions.
items.zh: 这样一来，我们就面临两个非常艰难的选择

items.en: We could either cull the troops, which is arguably the ecological solution,
items.zh: 我们可以选择扑杀这些狒狒群，这可以说是生态上的解决办法，

items.en: or we could find a space that we could set up an urban wildlife center
items.zh: 或者我们可以找一个地方，建一个城市野生动物中心，

items.en: and allow those animals in those troops to live out their lives
items.zh: 让那些狒狒群里的动物在那里安然度过余生，

items.en: in a high standard of care with a quality of environment.
items.zh: 享有高标准的照护和优质的环境

items.en: But that plan has sparked an outcry and fierce debate.
items.zh: 但这项计划引发了强烈抗议和激烈辩论

items.en: Should baboons that have adapted to city life be confined,
items.zh: 已经适应城市生活的狒狒，究竟应该被圈禁，

items.en: or should people find a way to coexist with them?
items.zh: 还是人们应该找到与它们共存的方式？

items.en: Sue Ann Norton says she regularly feeds fruit to baboons that visit her home.
items.zh: 苏·安·诺顿说，她定期给来家里的狒狒喂水果

items.en: They're not dangerous.
items.zh: 它们并不危险

items.en: They treat you as you treat them.
items.zh: 你怎么对它们，它们就怎么对你

items.en: If you treat them with anger and force, they come back at you with force.
items.zh: 如果你带着愤怒和暴力对待它们，它们也会用暴力回击

items.en: If you treat them like a pet, like a cat or a dog,
items.zh: 如果你像对待宠物一样对待它们，像对待猫或狗一样，

items.en: like I treat them,
items.zh: 就像我这样对待它们，

items.en: then we live together in harmony.
items.zh: 那么我们就能和谐地生活在一起

items.en: City officials say the baboons will be better off if they're confined.
items.zh: 市政官员表示，把狒狒圈养起来对它们更好

items.en: These are not wild baboons anymore.
items.zh: 它们已经不再是野生狒狒了

items.en: They live in an urban area.
items.zh: 它们生活在城市环境中

items.en: And what they are getting, whether we agree or disagree,
items.zh: 而它们得到的⸺不管我们同意还是不同意⸺

items.en: they are going to live their lives better for 30 years.
items.zh: 它们会过得更好，能活30年

items.en: Animal welfare groups say the root of the problem isn't the baboons.
items.zh: 动物福利组织表示，问题的根源并不在狒狒，

items.en: It's urban encroachment.
items.zh: 而在于城市扩张侵占自然

items.en: They argue residents need to do more to secure their homes,
items.zh: 他们认为，居民需要做更多来加固住宅、

items.en: protect trash, and eliminate easy access to food.
items.zh: 保管好垃圾，并消除容易获取食物的途径

items.en: If you are living in an area where there is wildlife,
items.zh: 如果你居住在有野生动物的地区，

items.en: then you need to live and coexist with the wildlife.
items.zh: 那么你就需要与野生动物共同生活、和平共处

items.en: With the residents now taking to the streets in protest,
items.zh: 如今居民走上街头抗议，

items.en: the battle over Cape Town's baboons comes down to one question.
items.zh: 围绕开普敦狒狒的争端归结为一个问题

items.en: Can people and wildlife learn to share the city,
items.zh: 人类和野生动物能否学会共享这座城市，

items.en: or will one have to make way for the other?
items.zh: 还是一方必须为另一方让路？

items.en: Activists in Kathmandu, Nepal, held a silent protest and candle vigil
items.zh: 在尼泊尔加德满都，活动人士在周末举行了静默抗议和烛光守夜，

items.en: over the weekend, demanding more action from the world on climate change.
items.zh: 要求世界各国在气候变化问题上采取更多行动

items.en: The nation is still reeling from a collapse of a glacier in late August
items.zh: 这个国家仍在承受8月底冰川崩塌带来的冲击，

items.en: that triggered catastrophic flooding.
items.zh: 那次崩塌引发了灾难性的洪水

items.en: It killed more than 1,300 people and left thousands missing.
items.zh: 洪水造成1300多人死亡，数千人失踪

items.en: Activists honored those victims during the event.
items.zh: 活动人士在活动中悼念了这些遇难者

items.en: One demonstrator talked about the reason he decided to participate.
items.zh: 一名示威者谈到他决定参加的原因

items.en: This is not a protest.
items.zh: 这不是一场抗议

items.en: We are silently just making all the crowd, all the public to recognize
items.zh: 我们只是静静地让所有人群、所有公众认识到

items.en: the climate change and how it is affecting Nepal,
items.zh: 气候变化以及它对尼泊尔造成的影响，

items.en: despite its contribution is very low,
items.zh: 尽管尼泊尔的排放贡献非常低，

items.en: like Nepal is contributing 0.027% in the carbon emission,
items.zh: 比如尼泊尔的碳排放只占全球碳排放的

items.en: global carbon emission. 0.027%
And we are getting all the, you know, climate-related hazards.
items.zh: 而我们却在承受所有与气候相关的灾害

items.en: And we are, the youth are here to show the solidarity
items.zh: 而我们在这里，年轻人们在此展示团结

items.en: to the people who lost their life in the Roswa Borticoci flood.
items.zh: 与在罗斯瓦·博尔蒂科奇洪水中失去生命的人们同在

items.en: Time for 10-second trivia.
items.zh: 又到了十秒冷知识时间

items.en: The first T-Rex fossil was discovered in which U.S. state?
items.zh: 第一具霸王鼠化石是在美国哪个州发现的？

items.en: Montana, Wyoming, South Dakota, or New Mexico?
items.zh: 蒙大拿、怀俄明、南达科他，还是新墨西哥？

items.en: If you said Montana, put your hands up.
items.zh: 如果你答的是蒙大拿，请举手

items.en: The first T-Rex fossil was discovered in 1902 in Montana.
items.zh: 第一具霸王鼠化石于1902年在蒙大拿被发现

items.en: In 1905, the dinosaur was officially named Tyrannosaurus rex, 1905
items.zh: 年，这种恐鼠被正式命名为 Tyrannosaurus rex,

items.en: meaning tyrant lizard king.
items.zh: 意思是“暴君蜥蜴王”

items.en: For decades, scientists have debated whether the T-Rex was more like
items.zh: 几十年来，科学家们一直在争论霸王鼠更像

items.en: a cold-blooded lizard or a warm-blooded bird.
items.zh: 冷血蜥蜴还是温血鳥类

items.en: Now, they may finally have their answer.
items.zh: 现在，他们可能终于有了答案

items.en: Researchers at the University of California studied the chemical makeup
items.zh: 加州大学的研究人员研究了三颗霸王鼠牙鼎化石的化学成分，

items.en: of three fossilized T-Rex teeth and found that the dinosaur had
items.zh: 发现这种恐鼠的

items.en: a body temperature of about 97 degrees Fahrenheit,
items.zh: 体温大约为华氏97度，

items.en: surprisingly close to ours.
items.zh: 惊人地接近我们的体温

items.en: That warmer body temperature suggests T-Rex could generate
items.zh: 这种较高的体温表明霸王鼠能够产生

items.en: and maintain its own body heat.
items.zh: 并维持自身的体温

items.en: And that could help explain how this massive predator was able to live
items.zh: 这可能有助于解释这种庞大的捕食者为何能生活在

items.en: across a huge range of climates,
items.zh: 跨度巨大的各种气候环境中，

items.en: including places as far north as what is now Alaska.
items.zh: 包括北至如今阿拉斯加的地区

items.en: So, while T-Rex disappeared about 66 million years ago,
items.zh: 所以，虽然霸王鼠约在6600万年前就已消失，

items.en: scientists are still finding new clues about how it lived.
items.zh: 科学家们仍在不断发现关于它如何生活的新线索

items.en: Tomorrow marks the autumnal equinox in the Northern Hemisphere,
items.zh: 明天就是北半球的秋分，

items.en: and many of us may be noticing that Mother Nature is starting to show off.
items.zh: 我们很多人可能会注意到大自然母亲开始展现风采了

items.en: Fall foliage colors are popping, with trees starting to turn
items.zh: 秋叶色彩正在绽放，树木开始变成

items.en: brilliant shades of yellow, red, and orange.
items.zh: 灿烂的黄、红、橙色调

items.en: But have you ever wondered why and how we get this colorful show
items.zh: 但你可曾想过，我们为什么以及如何能看到这场色彩盛宴，

items.en: each and every year?
items.zh: 而且年复一年？

items.en: Fall foliage colors are popping, with trees starting to turn
items.zh: 秋叶色彩正在绽放，树木开始变成

items.en: brilliant shades of yellow, red, and orange.
items.zh: 灿烂的黄、红、橙色调

items.en: Have you ever wondered why and how the leaves change colors?
items.zh: 你可曾想过，树叶为什么会变色、又是如何变色的？

items.en: Who better to ask than our CNN meteorologist, our weather wizard,
items.zh: 还有谁比我们的CNN 气象学家、天气魔法师

items.en: Allison Chinchar.
items.zh: 艾莉森·钦查尔更适合来回答呢

items.en: So great to see you, looking fall-tastic today with your display.
items.zh: 见到你太好了，今天你这身造型很有秋日气息

items.en: Speaking of display, how do these leaves change color?
items.zh: 说到展示，这些树叶是怎么变色的？

items.en: Why do they change color?
items.zh: 它们为什么会变色？

items.en: And how do they know when to start?
items.zh: 它们又是怎么知道什么时候该开始？

items.en: Right, because sometimes they change a little bit later in the year
items.zh: 对，因为有时候它们变色会比

items.en: versus others.
items.zh: 其他年份稍晚一些

items.en: So, yeah, there's a lot of factors here, Koi.
items.zh: 是的，这里有很多因素，科伊

items.en: But the biggest one is daylight hours.
items.zh: 但最大的一个是日照时长

items.en: As the days start to get shorter and we have less and less daylight
items.zh: 随着白昼开始变短，我们获得的日照越来越少，

items.en: as we head into winter, it's essentially kind of a cue to them
items.zh: 在进入冬季的过程中，这基本上是给它们一个信号，

items.en: to stop photosynthesizing.
items.zh: 让它们停止光合作用

items.en: Now, photosynthesis is basically using the sunlight
items.zh: 光合作用基本上是利用阳光

items.en: to give them food and energy.
items.zh: 为它们提供养分和能量

items.en: But this process slows incredibly in the winter months,
items.zh: 但这个过程在冬季会大幅减缓，

items.en: so the trees aren't dying, they're just going dormant.
items.zh: 所以树木并不是在死去，它们只是进入休眠状态

items.en: Why do some leaves turn red, like this one?
items.zh: 为什么有些树叶会变红，就像这片一样？

items.en: Right, so not all trees have this special gift
items.zh: 对，并不是所有树木都有这种特殊天赋，

items.en: that allows them to be this beautiful color.
items.zh: 能让它们呈现这么美的颜色

items.en: Basically, what they have inside of them is something called anthocyanin,
items.zh: 基本上，它们体内含有一种叫花青素的物质，

items.en: and it allows these trees, when they start to go through
items.zh: 当这些树木在冬季经历

items.en: that photosynthesis process in the winter, when they slow down,
items.zh: 光合作用过程、速度放慢时，

items.en: they're changing into this beautiful red or sometimes even that pretty purple color,
items.zh: 它们就会变成这种美丽的红色，有时甚至是漂亮的紫色，

items.en: all because they have this special ingredient.
items.zh: 全都因为它们拥有这种特殊成分

items.en: But you also have to have the right weather conditions.
items.zh: 但你还需要合适的天气条件

items.en: You have to make sure you've had enough water leading up to the fall season
items.zh: 你必须确保在进入秋季之前有足够的水分，

items.en: and also plenty of sunlight.
items.zh: 还要有充足的日照

items.en: Now, why is it that some trees don't change colors and nothing falls?
items.zh: 那么，为什么有些树不变色，叶子也不掉落呢？

items.en: Right, so these are what we refer to as evergreen, hence the color, trees.
items.zh: 对，这些就是我们所说的常绿树，因此才叫常绿

items.en: Basically, these trees have evolved so that they never stop
items.zh: 基本上，这些树已经进化到从不停止

items.en: going through the photosynthesis process.
items.zh: 进行光合作用

items.en: Now, it slows considerably in the winter, but it never actually stops,
items.zh: 虽然冬天光合作用会大幅减缓，但从未真正停止，

items.en: meaning they don't have to lose their leaves or change their color.
items.zh: 这意味着它们不必落叶或变色

items.en: In this warming climate environment
items.zh: 在我们如今生活并经历着的

items.en: that we're living and we're experiencing nowadays,
items.zh: 日益变暖的气候环境中，

items.en: how might warming temperatures around the world
items.zh: 全球气温升高会如何

items.en: affect the changing colors of the leaves?
items.zh: 影响叶子的颜色变化？

items.en: Right, so the most obvious answer to that is
items.zh: 对，最明显的答案是，

items.en: the leaves will be falling off much later into the season
items.zh: 叶子掉落的时间会推迟到季节很晚的时候，

items.en: because we're staying warmer longer.
items.zh: 因为我们保持温暖的时间更长了

items.en: If trees could actually pick their ideal conditions,
items.zh: 如果树木真的能选择理想条件，

items.en: it would be for the temperatures to cool down gradually,
items.zh: 那会是气温逐渐下降，

items.en: like you and I would probably pick.
items.zh: 就像你我可能也会选的那样

items.en: But if temperatures drop too quick,
items.zh: 但如果气温降得太快，

items.en: let's say 30 to 50 degrees in just a couple of days,
items.zh: 比如短短几天内骤降30到50华氏度，

items.en: trees can go through what's called shock,
items.zh: 树木就会经历所谓的“休克”,

items.en: which causes them to just drop their leaves,
items.zh: 导致它们直接落叶，

items.en: even if they never ended up fully changing colors.
items.zh: 即使叶子还没来得及完全变色

items.en: So why do trees decide to let their leaves go?
items.zh: 那么，树木为什么会决定让叶子脱落呢？

items.en: Is this like a preservation thing
items.zh: 这是不是一种保存自身的机制，

items.en: that some of they have to do?
items.zh: 是有些树必须做的？

items.en: It's to really save a lot of the energy
items.zh: 这其实是为了大量保存

items.en: that the tree would use up during the winter.
items.zh: 树木在冬天会消耗的能量

items.en: Many people don't know this,
items.zh: 很多人不知道，

items.en: but leaves take up the vast majority
items.zh: 叶子消耗了树木所吸收的

items.en: of the water source that a tree takes in.
items.zh: 绝大部分水源

items.en: So if it doesn't have its leaves anymore,
items.zh: 所以，如果不再有叶子，

items.en: it can consolidate a lot of that energy
items.zh: 它就能集中大量能量，

items.en: to get through a rough winter.
items.zh: 来度过一个艰难的冬天

items.en: Thank you for helping us branch out today
items.zh: 谢谢你今天帮我们拓展了知识，

items.en: and get to the root of this very interesting topic.
items.zh: 也让我们深入到这个有趣话题的根本

items.en: Today's story getting a 10 out of 10,
items.zh: 今天的故事获得满分10分，

items.zh: 明尼阿波利斯的一个培训项目

items.en: that aims to help more women become firefighters.
items.zh: 旨在帮助更多女性成为消防员

items.zh: 我们想推动女性不只是达到标准

items.en: We want them to crush glass ceilings.
items.zh: 我们想让她们打破玻璃天花板

items.zh: 我们想让她们站出来，让人无法否认

items.zh: 她们有资格站在那里，因为我们确实有资格

items.zh: 根据美国国家消防协会的数据，

items.en: And the trainers in this program are trying to fight the stigma
items.zh: 这个项目的训练员们正在努力打破

items.zh: 女性无法满足体能要求的偏见

items.en: When they call 911,
items.zh: 当人们拨打911时，

items.en: they're calling you on their worst day
items.zh: 他们是在最糟糕的一天向你求助，

items.en: and they need you to come and save them.
items.zh: 他们需要你去救他们

items.zh: 你必须为此做好身体上的准备

items.zh: 消防是一份对体能要求极高的工作，

items.en: and we must be prepared for that.
items.zh: 我们必须为此做好准备

items.en: You're literally doing this to save a life.
items.zh: 你做这些真的就是为了救人一命

items.en: You being in shape and physically prepared
items.zh: 你保持良好的体能状态，

items.en: can determine if someone lives or dies.
items.zh: 可能决定一个人的生死

items.en: One workout at a time,
items.zh: 每一次训练，

items.en: those women are proving that the desire to help people
items.zh: 这些女性都在证明，想要帮助他人的意愿

items.en: is one of the most heroic actions of all.
items.zh: 是所有行动中最英勇的一种

items.en: All right, superstars,
items.zh: 好了，超级明星们，

items.zh: 今天我还有时间喊一次话

items.zh: 这要送给利特尔老师，

items.zh: 她在博内尔青少年惩教中心，

items.zh: 位于弗吉尼亚州博内尔

items.zh: 非常感谢你们订阅我们的 YouTube频道，
